about.heading: About Me
about.subtitle: The Story and Journey
paragraphs: My name is Md. Nazrul Islam. I grew up with a passion for Islamic education from an early age. My educational journey began with completing the full memorization (Hifz) of the Holy Quran at a Maktab.

I then went on to study continuously in the Kitab (advanced Islamic studies) department, while also gaining proficiency in English. By the boundless mercy of Allah, I was also blessed with the opportunity to perform the sacred Umrah.
I am currently residing in Egypt, pursuing higher education at Al-Azhar University. I continue my studies regularly with the goal of acquiring Islamic knowledge.

highlights.title: Performed the Sacred Umrah
highlights.description: By the boundless mercy of Allah, I had the fortune of traveling to Saudi Arabia to perform the sacred Umrah, staying there for about seven days to complete the pilgrimage.

highlights.title: Moved to Egypt for Higher Education
highlights.description: Currently residing in Egypt and pursuing higher education at Al-Azhar University, continuing my studies regularly with the goal of acquiring Islamic knowledge.

vision.title: Vision
vision.description: To become a knowledgeable and righteous scholar of Islam who preserves the Quran in both heart and practice, and to serve as a source of guidance and benefit for the Muslim Ummah.

mission.title: Mission
mission.description: To continue pursuing authentic Islamic knowledge with sincerity and diligence, to uphold and pass on the teachings of the Quran and Sunnah, and to dedicate my life to the service of Islam and humanity.

faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to what people ask me most

items.question: What does it mean to be a Hafiz-e-Quran?
items.answer: A Hafiz-e-Quran is someone who has memorized the entire Holy Quran by heart. I completed this at a Maktab in my childhood and continue to revise it regularly to keep it fresh in memory.

items.question: What are you currently studying at Al-Azhar University?
items.answer: I am pursuing Islamic higher studies at Al-Azhar University in Egypt, continuing the path I began with Hifz and the Kitab department, with the goal of deepening my Islamic knowledge.

items.question: How did your educational journey begin?
items.answer: It began with completing the full memorization of the Holy Quran at Omar Khattab (RA) Madrasa. I then studied in the Kitab department, completed Hedayatun Naho, and took an English language course before moving to Egypt for higher education.

items.question: Have you performed Umrah?
items.answer: Yes, by the mercy of Allah I had the opportunity to perform Umrah in Saudi Arabia, staying there for about a week to complete the pilgrimage.

items.question: Can I ask you a religious question or request guidance?
items.answer: Yes, feel free to reach out through the contact section below. I try to respond to messages as time permits alongside my studies.

items.question: Do you offer Quran classes or tutoring?
items.answer: I am currently focused on my studies at Al-Azhar University. If you're interested in guidance or classes, please get in touch through the contact form and I will let you know what is possible.
